message.content:
I don’t track how many drones each company has—it’s not my job. The companies manage their own fleets, and I don’t need to know their exact numbers to do my work.

What *does* matter to me is how many of their drones might be affected by a closure. For example, if a corridor gets blocked, I can see if multiple companies have drones flying through it at the same time. But I don’t know how many drones they have in total. You’d have to ask them.
